definition.note: Polynomial not stored: no closed form is stored for this surface; it is defined by its shipped implementation. The shipped implementation in math_art/surfaces/algebraic.py is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
